data.description: Experience luxurious suburban living in Ajman while staying seamlessly connected to key destinations.

data.answer:
Al Zorah is a master-planned development on Ajman’s northern coast. The area spans pristine beaches and lush mangroves, creating a picturesque environment combining natural beauty and urban sophistication. 

The neighborhood also features high-end resorts, an 18-hole golf course, and marina access. Families, professionals, and retirees find living in Al Zorah particularly appealing due to its safe, serene, and well-maintained surroundings.

Al Zorah Real Estate offers an impressive range of residential properties, including Al Zorah Villas, townhouses, and apartments. Al Zorah Properties are designed to maximize natural light, with open-plan spaces and large windows offering views of the beach, golf courses, or mangroves. 

Villas range from 3 to 6 bedrooms, with prices starting from AED 2,308,000 for 3-bedroom units. Al Zorah Villas are especially popular for those looking for spacious, private homes. With continuous development, renting and buying property in Al Zorah are attractive prospects for investors and end-users.

Popular Sub-Communities in Al Zorah

Al Zorah boasts a collection of impressive residential complexes. Among the most popular are The Shores and The Fairways. The Shores features beachfront villas, apartments, and luxury hotels, offering residents direct access to the beach. 

The Fairways, on the other hand, is set around an 18-hole golf course and is ideal for those seeking a golf-centric lifestyle. These communities stand out for their architectural beauty, serene surroundings, and proximity to essential amenities. Each neighborhood provides a unique living experience, from cozy apartments to grand villas.

The Coves is another sub-community in the area, featuring both residential and hotel spaces alongside three marinas. The Gates offers high-rise towers and retail facilities, while The Avenues boasts leisure attractions, shopping centers, and a central marina.

Renting a Property in Al Zorah

Renting in Al Zorah provides a luxurious lifestyle without the long-term commitment of ownership. The rental market in Al Zorah is diverse, offering apartments, villas, and townhouses. A 4-bedroom villa can be rented for approximately AED 165,000 per year. 

While the area is still developing, those seeking a premium living experience close to nature will find Al Zorah a great option. As development continues, more properties will be available for rent, expanding the choices for tenants in this vibrant community.

Buying a Property in Al Zorah

Buying property in Al Zorah is a wise investment for those seeking luxury living in a growing market. Villas in Al Zorah offer expansive living spaces, with 3-bedroom villas starting at AED 2,308,000 and larger 5-bedroom villas up to AED 5,737,000. 

Al Zorah Properties offers a unique combination of luxury and natural beauty. As the area continues to develop, the potential for capital appreciation attracts investors. Whether you want to live here or invest, Al Zorah Real Estate promises high returns and a serene lifestyle.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Al Zorah?

data.answer:
Life in Al Zorah is serene, upscale, and connected with nature. Residents enjoy proximity to mangroves, beaches, and golf courses, promoting an active, outdoor lifestyle. Al Zorah amenities are first-class, ranging from high-end resorts to fitness centers, making it perfect for relaxation and recreation. Living in Al Zorah combines peace, privacy, and the convenience of nearby cities like Dubai.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Al Zorah

Al Zorah offers ample parking options, with each villa and apartment complex featuring dedicated parking spaces. 
Public transportation in Al Zorah is limited, with taxis being the primary mode of transport for residents and visitors. While there are no metro or bus routes directly serving the area, nearby public transport options are accessible in Ajman city center, which is a short drive away. Residents typically rely on private vehicles or ride-hailing services for convenience. For those commuting to Dubai or other emirates, the location offers easy access to major highways, ensuring smooth connectivity.

Supermarkets in Al Zorah

Though there are no supermarkets within Al Zorah itself, several are easily accessible within a short drive. Popular supermarkets near Al Zorah include Paradise Supermarket, Freshly Supermarket, and Shuaa Al Madina Supermarket. Residents can visit Nesto Hypermarket and Suncity Hypermarket, just 10 minutes away, for more extensive shopping needs.

Shopping Mall in Al Zorah

Al Zorah residents can enjoy nearby shopping at Flamingo Mall, which offers a variety of retail outlets and essential services. City Centre Ajman is a 13-minute drive away for a larger store selection. This famous Al Zorah mall features a mix of local and international brands, a hypermarket, and dining options, making it a convenient shopping destination for residents.

Schools and Nurseries in Al Zorah

Schools near Al Zorah Ajman offer excellent educational options. Ajman American Private School, just 10 minutes away, offers an American curriculum from kindergarten to grade 12 and top facilities like an indoor sports hall and medical clinic. 

Other nearby schools include Pakistani School Ajman and Royal Academy Ajman. Gulf Medical University in Al Jurf offers medical, dentistry, and pharmacy programs for higher education, while Ajman University provides 36 graduate and undergraduate programs across nine colleges. Both universities are accessible within a 10-minute drive via Al Ittihad Street.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Al Zorah Location

Muslim residents of Al Zorah can attend prayers at nearby mosques such as Sheikh Zayed Mosque and Suraqqah Bin Malik Mosque. Christian residents can visit Winners Chapel International Ajman or Greater Light of God Church Ajman within a 10-minute drive. Hindu temples are located in Dubai, about 45 minutes away by car.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Al Zorah Area

Al Zorah is home to Skin and Teeth Medical Centre, which provides specialized dentistry and skincare services. Derma Art Clinic offers cosmetic and laser treatments. For more comprehensive medical care, residents can visit nearby hospitals, Ajman Specialty General Hospital and Sheikh Khalifa Medical City, both less than 15 minutes away.

Al Zorah Location & Nearby Areas

Al Zorah Ajman is ideally located on the northern coast, providing easy access to key areas. Al Ittihad Street connects Al Zorah to Sharjah and Dubai, with Dubai just 35 minutes away. Nearby areas include Al Bustan, Al Nakhil, and Al Jurf. 

Major landmarks like Ajman University and Ajman China Mall are within a 10-minute drive. Sharjah International Airport is a 24-minute drive, while Tallah Camel Course is 20 minutes away. This strategic Al Zorah Ajman location makes it a tranquil yet well-connected community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Zorah Area

data.answer:
Al Zorah offers a range of leisure activities, from outdoor sports to cultural attractions. Al Zorah lifestyle includes access to the Al Zorah Golf Club, a popular destination for golf enthusiasts. The Al Zorah Beach Ajman is ideal for water sports like kayaking and paddle boarding. The nearby Al Zorah Natural Reserve is a haven for birdwatchers and nature lovers.

Al Zorah Dubai Restaurants

Al Zorah Ajman offers a variety of dining experiences. Aquario at The Oberoi Beach Resort serves fresh seafood with stunning sea views, while The Grove at Al Zorah Golf Club is known for shisha and Middle Eastern cuisine. Litchy Sushi Lounge and Thanani at The Pavilion offer diverse options within the community. 
Al Zorah Marina 1 features F&B outlets like Colorato, Aquabrown Coffee, Z Lounge, and Operation Falafel. Nearby Ajman Corniche, just a 20-minute drive, boasts top restaurants like Bukhara, Sultan Saray, and Themar Al Bahar Restaurant.

Beaches Near Al Zorah

Al Zorah Beach Ajman is the perfect getaway for residents and visitors alike. This beautiful sandy beach is ideal for water sports, sunbathing, or relaxing by the shore. Caravana Al Zorah Beach Resort offers camping and recreational activities like quad biking and horse riding. The beach is accessible within minutes from most residential areas in Al Zorah.

Hotels in Al Zorah Area

Al Zorah is home to some of the most luxurious hotels in Ajman, including Oberoi Al Zorah Beach Resort. It offers a luxurious beachfront escape with elegant villas and suites surrounded by lush mangroves. Guests can enjoy world-class dining, a serene spa, and a private beach with crystal-clear waters. The resort provides a perfect blend of relaxation and recreation, just 25 minutes from Dubai.

LUX Al Zorah is another 5-star hotel in the area, offering a range of rooms, private villas, and multiple entertainment options. The property features two restaurants, two bars, a café, and a tea house.

Moreover, you can visit Caravana Al Zorah Resort. This stunning hotel in Al Zorah is where guests can enjoy direct beach access, water activities, and outdoor dining for a laid-back, immersive getaway

Community Events

Al Zorah hosts community events at Marina 1, where residents can enjoy concerts, exhibitions, and other gatherings. The event spaces also cater to weddings, corporate functions, and social events, making Marina 1 a vibrant social hub within the community.

Al Zorah Attractions and Landmarks

Al Zorah Ajman offers top attractions like the Al Zorah Natural Reserve, home to over 60 bird species, including flamingos and herons. Visitors can explore the mangroves via kayak, with the reserve recognized by the Ramsar Convention. 

The Al Zorah Golf Club, designed by Nicklaus Design, provides a stunning par-72 course amidst mangroves and dunes. Caravana Al Zorah offers camping, horse riding, and kayaking, while Marina 1 features over 15 restaurants and leisure options. Guests can also charter the luxurious NORDIC STAR yacht for an unforgettable experience at Al Zorah Dubai.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

The Al Zorah Ajman neighborhood offers diverse outdoor activities for residents and visitors. There's something for everyone, whether cycling, jogging along the scenic natural trails, or leisurely walks on dedicated walkways. Al Zorah amenities also include well-designed playgrounds with sports facilities like basketball, volleyball, and soccer, catering to children and adults. 

For water enthusiasts, the Al Zorah Beach Ajman features a water sports center offering motorized and non-motorized activities. Visitors can also enjoy Seaplane Tours by SeaWings for breathtaking aerial views of Ajman’s landscape.

Fitness enthusiasts can head to My30 Minutes Gym in Al Zorah, which offers state-of-the-art exercise equipment. Those seeking relaxation can visit The Oberoi Beach Resort and LUX Al Zorah spas, providing luxurious wellness experiences. Beauty services are also available at the 90’s Beauty Salon and Moon Village Massage and Relaxation Centre, making Al Zorah Ajman a haven for fitness and relaxation.

While Al Zorah offers a luxurious and peaceful lifestyle, it's still under development, so some amenities may take time to complete. Public transportation is limited, so owning a car is highly recommended.

What are the best Al Zorah restaurants?  

Al Zorah offers a variety of dining options, including Aquario at The Oberoi Beach Resort, The Grove at Al Zorah Golf Club, and eateries at Marina 1, like Operation Falafel and Z Lounge.

What are the main attractions in Al Zorah area?  

Al Zorah's top attractions include the Al Zorah Natural Reserve, Al Zorah Golf Club, and Marina 1, where you can find dining and recreational activities.

What makes Al Zorah an ideal place to live?  

Al Zorah combines luxury living with pristine beaches and proximity to Dubai. Its natural surroundings and upscale amenities make it a top choice for families and professionals.

What amenities does Al Zorah offer?  

Al Zorah offers world-class amenities like beachfront villas, golf courses, water sports centers, and luxurious resorts, providing a balanced lifestyle of recreation and relaxation.

What is covered in the Al Zorah Guide?  

The Al Zorah Guide highlights its neighborhoods, properties, amenities, lifestyle, and nearby attractions, offering a comprehensive overview of this premium community.

What are the key Al Zorah neighborhoods?  

Al Zorah is home to popular neighborhoods like The Shores and The Fairways, offering beachfront villas and residences centered around the golf course.

What outdoor activities are available in Al Zorah?  

Residents can enjoy jogging and cycling trails, water sports, kayaking, and Seaplane Tours by SeaWings, making it a perfect place for outdoor enthusiasts.

How accessible is Al Zorah from Dubai?  

Al Zorah is conveniently located just 35 minutes from Dubai via Al Ittihad Street, making it a tranquil yet accessible option for those working there.

nodes.title: Creekside Residence
nodes.about:
Creekside Residence in Al Zorah City redefines waterfront living with its elegant, Mediterranean-inspired architecture and natural surroundings. Located in Al Zorah City, Ajman, and developed by Al Zorah Development Company, this low-rise development features 8 floors of refined residences. It offers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments each designed to integrate seamlessly with the environment while providing sophisticated living spaces.

With serene views of the mangroves, creek, and fairways, Creekside Residence offers more than just homes—it presents a lifestyle rooted in wellness and tranquility. Select amenities such as internal gardens, a multipurpose room, and a state-of-the-art gym enhance the quality of everyday life. Its amphitheater-style layout, sustainable design, and access to premium leisure destinations make it an exceptional choice for discerning homeowners and investors.

nodes.title: Park Golf Residence
nodes.about:
Park Golf Residence is a unique residential complex set against a backdrop of lush vegetation and a golf course in the elegant coastal area of Al Zorah City, Ajman. Designed with meticulous attention to detail, the complex reflects timeless beauty and sophistication.

There are studios, 1-bedroom apartments,  3-bedroom penthouse, as well as a three-bedroom villa. The design of the apartments combines elegance with comfort, and luxurious details create a sense of refined sophistication.It offers a variety of carefully designed amenities, including an 18-hole golf course, an exclusive fitness center, infinity pools and beautifully manicured gardens.The ideally located Park Golf Residence provides unobstructed access to major highways and is just a 25-minute drive from Dubai International Airport.
